uncited: It builds on [Differentiable Inverse Graphics Framework](7617-differentiable-inverse-graphics-framework.md) by introducing a specific mechanism for handling coordinate uncertainty through joint optimization of representation parameters and input coordinates.
The method models the measurement space as a continuous function that maps measurement coordinates to sampled measurements.
*   **Measurement Representation $r_\phi(\cdot)$:** A continuous function parameterized by $\phi$.

*   **Consistency Loss with Updating Coordinates:** Using the continually updating learned coordinates $\nu$ in the consistency loss $L_{\text{consistency}}$ requires rebuilding the forward operator $A_\nu$ after each iteration.
A type of measurement representation using Fourier feature mapping and fully-connected layers.
An alternative representation using Non-uniform Rational Basis Splines.
*   **Time Complexity:** The optimization involves gradient-based updates for both representation parameters and input coordinates.
